people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahweh as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
translations.bsb: So Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of his father David. He prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
translations.kjv: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
translations.asv: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Jehovah as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
